class.name: HEGoGraphAttributeDef
class.brief_description: One attribute a [HEGoGraphInput3D] can store on its points or connections.
class.description: Lives in a [HEGoGraphAttributes] list on a child of the graph. The name, owner and value type decide what is sent to Houdini; the rest only shapes the editor UI.

method.name: make_array
method.description: A packed array of [param size] filled with [method default_value].

method.name: matches_array
method.description: Whether [param array] is the packed type this definition stores.

members.member: Houdini attribute name. Must be unique per owner on one graph.
Whether this attribute is stored on points or on connections (Houdini prims).
Default for a newly created point or connection when [member value_type] is FLOAT.
Default for a newly created point or connection when [member value_type] is INT.
Default for a newly created point or connection when [member value_type] is STRING.
When [member value_type] is INT, the editor shows a checkbox and stores 0 or 1.
When [member value_type] is STRING and this is not empty, the editor shows a dropdown.
